title: Chapter 159 - 159 Great Harvest; 9,300 Red Packets!
content:
Chapter 159 - 159 Great Harvest; 9,300 Red Packets!

Chapter 159 - 159 Great Harvest; 9,300 Red Packets!

159 Great Harvest; 9,300 Red Packets!

At this moment, delicacies were slowly served.

Shrimp and celery heart, dried phoenix chicken, amber peach kernels, fried red fruits, braised fish, white braised abalone, soft fried fresh shellfish, egg chicken soup…

Each dish was gorgeous in color, beautiful in shape, and filled with fragrance.

Now, the economic formula had been successfully derived.

Everyone was in a good mood and had a good appetite. It was a good time to eat.

Everyone ate happily. They even drank a little wine, and their faces turned red.

Initially, Lin Fan was prepared to treat them.

However, Professor Feng said that she had witnessed the emergence of the economic formula, so she had to treat him.

Seeing how insistent she was, Lin Fan decided to let her be.

Tomorrow was Monday.

In addition, Qin Yuxuan’s matter had already been settled.

Therefore, Lin Fan did not stay in Modu any longer. He bought a first-class ticket for the afternoon and headed to Jiangbei.

“Yuxuan has really found a good boyfriend,” Senior Fan praised sincerely.

“He’s not just a good boyfriend,” Senior Lu said. “He’s simply a perfect male god!”

“He spent more than 90 million to buy a big office in the Global Financial Building… Then, he gave 200 million yuan to our new company as start-up capital and investment capital!”

The more Senior Lu spoke, the more excited she became. She was dancing with joy.

Professor Feng, who was standing at the side, said in surprise, “He even took out so much money?”

Professor Feng was a financial expert and often dealt with very large amounts of money.

However, that money did not belong to an individual but to the company.

Taking out nearly 300 million yuan in one go?

Most likely, even a person with a net worth of more than ten billion yuan would not be able to take it out in a short period of time.

However, Lin Fan had done it.

How rich was Lin Fan exactly?

Unimaginable!

Professor Feng patted Qin Yuxuan’s shoulder and said, “A man like this is hard to control.”

Qin Yuxuan’s delicate body trembled slightly.

Soon, however, her beautiful eyes became determined again.

…

Yesterday, Lin Fan was exhausted for the entire night.

Therefore, as soon as he lay down on the spacious first-class seat, he quickly fell asleep.

When Lin Fan opened his eyes, he was already in Jiangbei.

Lin Fan drove the Lamborghini that he had left in the parking lot yesterday and headed toward the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex.

When the security guards standing at the entrance of Coiling Dragon Villa Complex saw Lin Fan, they all stood up straight and took the initiative to greet him.

Lin Fan greeted them and entered the villa near the lake.

Then, he turned his attention to the system.

[Do you wish to sign in?]

This was the new system ability he had obtained after spending 92.5 million yuan to purchase an office in the Global Financial Building.

Lin Fan had wanted to give it a try for a long time.

At this moment, without any hesitation, he said directly, “Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Modu Global Financial Tower 1.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan was stunned.

W-What was going on?

In other words, he had not only earned 900 million yuan by buying an office, but he also won an entire building?

This was the Global Financial Tower!

One office was worth nearly 100 million yuan.

How much would the entire building cost?

30 billion? 50 billion?

Lin Fan’s face was filled with a strange expression.

This trip to Modu was really not bad.

[Do you want to open the ten silver packets?]

This was the reward for completing the hidden mission when the funds exceeded one billion.

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received one million yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 300,000 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a Patek Phillipe 5002P.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 5% of the shares of Little Tanuki Group.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 yuan.]

…

From the ten silver packets, Lin Fan received a total of 2.9 million yuan, a Patek Phillipe 5002P, and 5% shares of the Little Tanuki Group!

Seeing this…

Even Lin Fan could not help but smile.

Little Tanuki Group was a super internet company comparable to Penguin with a market value of nearly five trillion!

5% of the shares meant that it was also worth about 250 billion yuan!

What a terrifying number!

Then, Lin Fan took out his phone.

[Do you wish to open 9,300 red packets?]

This…

They were from the 93 million yuan he had spent on his trip to Modu.

“9,300 red packets? Let me see what I can get,” Lin Fan said expectantly.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the Painting of Spring Trees and Autumn Frost.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 144 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100 stock trend cards for the next three days.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 5% of Gucci’s shares.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received one yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19,999 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a MEGAS4 wristwatch.]

…

From the 9,300 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 2,521,151 yuan.

He did not care about this bit of money at all.

After all, Lin Fan could earn at least 3.5 million yuan every day.

[100 stock trend cards for the next three days. After using it, you can randomly obtain the trend chart of 100 stocks in the next three days. With one word, you can determine the future and show your supreme charm. Note: When buying stocks, the amount of each stock should be less than 1% of the market value of the stock.]

Was this the way to increase the value of his money quickly?

Lin Fan skipped over it.

5% of Gucci’s shares?

Gucci was a world-renowned luxury bag and clothing company with a market value of about 500 billion yuan.

5% of the shares?

That was about 25 billion.

This was not bad.

When Lin Fan lifted his eyelids, there were two fashionable and cool watches in front of him.

Obviously, these were the MEGAS4 and the Patek Phillippe 5002P that he had just gotten from the silver and red packets.

Under the two watches was an exquisite ancient painting.

In the painting, two scholars sat cross-legged on a big rock, chatting softly, which was very artistic.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan threw the two watches aside. Then, he picked up the painting and admired it carefully.

“Is this Tang Bohu’s Painting of Spring Trees and Autumn Frost? It’s indeed well-drawn! No wonder Tang Bohu was able to chase after Qiuxiang.”

If someone who loved watches saw this scene, they would be heartbroken.

One had to know…

The two watches that Lin Fan casually threw out were the Patek Phillipe 5002P and the MEGAS4!

The 5002P was a super-complex functional watch, limited to no more than ten pieces worldwide! The price of each watch was more than 15 million!

The MEGAS4 was recognized as the most complicated watch in the world, and its price was also more than 15 million!

These two watches were priceless treasures!

In the end, they were thrown out just like that?

If they were knocked over, it would definitely be a loss for the watch industry!
